keep records and artifacts separate
record = canonical structured object in Ledger/export/search/routing
artifact = file/blob/renderable output linked from the record
review markdown summary = artifact; review record = structured ledger object
corroboration packet JSON/markdown = artifact; corroboration result record = structured object
low-risk read-only inspection: allowed on refreshing, often stale, sometimes degraded
precise navigation/deep-linking: usually allowed if target object identity still valid
live mutation/approval/recovery/retry/cleanup: require current or direct canonical-runtime validation path
none: safe navigation/focus actions, low-risk presentation, no user-data or live-runtime mutation
light: moderate-impact actions where accidental activation is plausible; short confirm or inline affordance
strong: actions that may discard local state, remove artifacts/worktrees, revoke accepted state, or materially change live execution; should show scope and consequence clearly
hard_gate: examples include HITL approvals, graph patch application when it changes canonical graph generation, remote-side-effect actions with explicit non-bypassable policy
palette-friendly: open/focus tab, jump to run/seam/package/node/lane/concern/review/patch/recovery, open inspector, run search routes, low-risk view and filter commands
palette-allowed but guarded: recover/retry/approve/decline/replan/restore/cleanup with canonical runtime semantics and confirmation rules
palette-discouraged or hidden by default: broad destructive bulk mutations with ambiguous target sets

pressure summary
projection trust states: current, refreshing, stale, degraded, unavailable
current: projection is caught up enough for normal use
refreshing: old committed projection still visible while refresh/rebuild runs
stale: projection is usable for context but may not reflect current runtime truth
degraded: projector/scan partially failed or a dependency signal is missing; some fields/sections are less trustworthy
unavailable: projection cannot currently answer the surface contract
provider/account pressure present
quota pressure severity
signal confidence
read-only navigation may continue on stale and some degraded projections if the UI says so clearly
live mutating / decision-bearing actions must tighten on trust state
stale: allow inspection and historical navigation; require refresh or direct runtime revalidation before sensitive live actions
degraded: restrict to safe inspection and canonical recovery paths; do not allow ambiguous live actions
unavailable: route to record-backed fallback views or explicit recovery/refresh actions
page state must not silently stand in for runtime state when freshness/trust is insufficient
